content.short: A collection of 11.111 unique NFTs/unique collectables living on the Cardano blockchain. This collection comes with a great cause.
content.description:
Today, the addax, a nomadic desert-living species, is the most threatened ungulate in the Sahara and quite possibly the world, and is listed as Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.

1 ADA will be donated to the Sahara Conservation Fund for each Addax sold. We also created a special category of Addaxes for this cause. 100 Addaxes with the 100% of the revenue being donated to the Sahara Conservation fund, with proof of donation on our Official channels, to provide financial support to this great cause.
